ncastle_guide.text: Welcome to Nottingham Castle. The Norman one is long gone. This is the later ducal mansion, built in the 1670s.
It was set on fire by rioters in 1831 during the Reform Bill unrest. It was rebuilt and opened in 1878 as a museum.
Under the city are more than 800 man-made caves. Through the castle rock runs Mortimer's Hole, a secret tunnel used in 1330 to catch Roger Mortimer.
The young King Edward III was behind the plan. He was only seventeen, which is a bold age to take charge of a kingdom.

ncastle_visitor.text: I came for Robin Hood. They told me he is outside, in bronze. He has not moved in decades. A calm fellow.
